avis.titre: I like it but have there's minor issues.
avis.texte: I'm in need of a new face cleanser and I heard good things about BYOMA, so I bought this jelly cleanser. It didn't leave any bad reaction and did help with making my skin feeling nice and clean (I do have a normal skin type and it's not sensitive either). And it does remove most of my makeup but not very well. There's still some mascara/eye makeup residue even after I rinse it twice. And another thing, is that it doesn't covers my entire face well. Like I have to do 4 pumps of the cleanser to be able to cover my whole face which is not ideal since I wanted to last long, especially at the price that I paid for. I will continue to use this product, but won't buy it again.

I don't know who wrote the description for this cleanser but whomever labeled it "ultra hydrating" lied! It is the opposite. It leaves your face feeling dry and stripped, and bot at ALL hydrated. My skin feels completely stripped every time I use this-- not sure how it is "barrier-restoring" or "moisturizing"; it feels like a cheap alcohol cleanser. I have to apply 3 different moisturizers after for it to feel better. I can't imagine what it would do to dry skin. It does remove makeup at least, but not very well. I like the pump and the value for the size, but pointless when the product isn't good.
Saw this had a lot of good reviews and was recommended by a store specialist but it didnt do anything for me besides clean my skin off. If anything my skin has worsened since starting this product.

avis.titre: Careful if you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: It could just be a weird reaction from me and my skin specifically. But when I used this, the skin around my eyes started to burn and lasted for almost an hour. And the skin around my eyes are still red and feel raw and it's been several days. I've only been using moisturizer since then because I dont want to add anything that will irritate it more. Again, maybe it's an unusual reaction but be careful if you have sensitive skin.

It kills me to say this because I have loved almost every product from BYOMA. However, this one just isn't it for me. What ruins this product for me is the way it's described: hydrating, gentle, perfect for all skin types. In reality, it is nothing of the sort. For reference I have dry-leaning combination skin, and everytime I tried to use this my skin felt dry, stripped and tight afterwards. Granted it made my skin feel very clean, but in the way that just feels really tight and uncomfortable. I like cleansers that make my skin feel squeaky clean, but this is just too much, especially since it is described as "hydrating." I think this would be better suited for very oily skin, and I wish the brand would say that instead of marketing it as being "for all skin types." I still love BYOMA, but this is currently my least favorite product from the brand.

I really love almost all Byoma products so it pains me to say this but I really didn't like this cleanser. It is advertised as a good daily cleanser option, that is hydrating and cleanses without leaving the skin stripped. I have dry-leaning combination skin, so I was really excited for this product. Unfortunately, I found that everytime I used this (I used it for about 3 weeks, every night) my skin felt extremely stripped and dry. I thought it might be the amount of product I was using so I tried using a bit less, but my skin still felt stripped, even in the areas of my face that tend to be a bit more oily. To be fair, my skin DEFINITELY felt very clean, albeit very stripped. Since I already bought the product, I just use it on mornings where I might've forgotten to cleanse the night before, to really get that "clean skin" feeling (and then just really lather up with moisturizer). I feel like this could be a good option for someone with very oily skin, but that is not at all how this is advertised. If you are someone with combo/normal/dry skin, I would personally not recommend this product.
